Evidence v book: (1) Haas-class CNC — mach-haas-vf2 agrees with the Haas EU list (EUR 65k); generic mach-vmc3 (EUR 94k) is ~45% above it; mach-haas-umc500 (EUR 154k) ~45% above the US-list conversion (EUR 106k); mach-vmc3-de (EUR 358k) is 3.6× a new German-built SPINNER VC1150 asking price (EUR 99k). The book's €13.70/h for mach-vmc3 is NOT driven by capex (depreciation + finance are only ~21% of the annual cost; energy and floor space are 62%), so the capex error moves the rate little. (2) Forging — forge-press-1600t / 2500t capital (EUR 0.69 M / 0.99 M, written off over 6.18 yr) looks low against EUR 2.6 M for a ~2,100–2,200 t press (Mosdorfer, unconfirmed) and CHF 13.5 M for a 3,000 t press project (Imbach); no 1,600 / 2,500 t price was found. (3) Aluminium extrusion — al-ext-press-1800t capital EUR 4.89 M v EUR 10 M for a 7" Presezzi automatic line (Vimetco, 2021–22); al-ext-press-2500t EUR 7.34 M v EUR 11 M for a line built around a SECOND-HAND 22 MN 8" press (Hydro Rackwitz, 2022–23); 12" row EUR 18.3 M v EUR 29 M (Hydro Tønder) / EUR 37.9 M (HAI 60 MN). The extrusion capital looks ~1.5–2× low. (4) Press brake — brake-trumpf-trubend3100 implied EUR 795k v a new TruBend 3100 at EUR 136k FCA Ditzingen (5.8×, high).

Operating model: euro-area bank rate for > EUR 1 M corporate loans 3.5–3.8% (July 2026) v book 4% on half the capex; ECB deposit rate 2.50% from 16 Sept 2026; AfA guide life for presses 14 yr v book 6.18 yr; two-shift hours 4,044 v book 4,000 (CNC) / 3,500 (presses) / 6,000 (extrusion); prime logistics rents EUR 6.40–11.00/m²/month, four-cluster mean 8.54.
